title: View bootstrap attaches computeQuestions output to readiness so the adapter feature-detects the real shape
description: After `computeReadiness` returns, the view bootstrap calls `computeQuestions(readiness, { tree, ledgers, profileText, persona: 'productOwner' })` and merges the result's `questions`, `groups`, `optional` and `engineer` fields onto the readiness object before it reaches `renderPage`. `preferReadinessQuestions` then returns true and `fromReadinessQuestions` reads the real `computeQuestions` output rather than falling back to the blockers path (AC-18002-1). The phrasebook stays available as the per-field fallback when a question carries no `ask` / `hint` of its own.
